status: Proposed additive interface; original design, not a device capture or hardware-qualified transport.

states.note: Show configured patterns in the actual current bank. A01 is illustrative. Unavailable or unknown slots carry X and refuse selection. Selecting a pattern consumes both pad-down and release; it does not produce a synth note.

ownership.toggle: PATTERN SELECT toggles the chooser; closing it restores synth pad notes. Exact start/stop controls and bank navigation remain owned by the native transport source worker.
ownership.priority: The direct recording destination chooser owns pads while active. A pattern chooser cannot steal those events. Preserve the frozen direct recording lifecycle and 120-second limit.
ownership.status: Render only source-backed current bank, pattern availability and native transport state. Do not imply a click getter or invent timing.
ownership.click: Use the existing native configured click. No new click control or status is introduced by this design.
